  = help: or consider exporting it for use by other crates

Smelt your TypeScript and Python into Rust

Usage: smelt [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  build        Read manifest, transpile, and emit a Rust crate
  check        Type-check and validate without emitting any output
  new          Scaffold a new smelt project
  dump-hir     Print compact HIR for a single source file
  dump-mir     Print the MIR for a single source file (debug)
  dump-ast     Print the raw parser AST for a single source file (Python only for now)
  clean        Remove the output target directory
  dump-schema  Print the JSON Schema for Smelt.toml
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --manifest-path <MANIFEST_PATH>  Path to Smelt.toml (defaults to ./)
  -h, --help                           Print help
  -V, --version                        Print version
